sections.label: The Shift
sections.heading: Higher education is undergoing a fundamental structural transformation.
sections.html:
The Shift

Higher education is undergoing a fundamental structural transformation.

Demographic shifts, credential disruption, workforce realignment, and evolving capital flows are redefining how institutions grow, how investors evaluate the sector, and how consulting firms serve their clients.

Cohort Science™ is purpose-built to address this challenge, providing the analytical depth and speed of delivery that consequential decisions demand.

sections.label: The Idea
sections.heading: A new foundation for education intelligence.
sections.html:
The Idea

A new foundation for education intelligence.

Cohort Science™ maintains a continuously updated intelligence base spanning labor markets, student demand, program economics, graduate outcomes, and geographic market dynamics.

Our proprietary econometric framework evaluates 100+ variables across labor market conditions, student demand signals, career value trajectories, and competitive positioning, producing market intelligence that is rigorous, reproducible, and ready when decisions need to be made.

Speed to insight

Structured intelligence delivered in hours, not weeks.

Analytical depth

Multi-variable econometric models built for institutional and investment-grade decisions.

Decision-ready output

Findings structured for boardrooms, investment committees, and client engagements.

sections.label: Clients
sections.heading: Sector Intelligence Built for Every Decision-Maker
sections.html:
Clients We Serve

Sector Intelligence Built for Every Decision-Maker

Institutional Leaders

Private and public colleges, faith-based institutions, and community colleges rely on Cohort Science™ to provide institutional leaders with a clear, continuous view of the student lifecycle, from recruitment through graduation and beyond. Designed for presidents, provosts, deans, and enrollment leaders, our platform transforms complex data into actionable intelligence that drives enrollment growth, strengthens student success, closes equity gaps, and demonstrates measurable outcomes to boards, accreditors, and strategic partners.

Foundations and Impact Investors

Today's most effective philanthropy is driven by evidence. Cohort Science™ equips foundations, impact investors, and mission-driven grantmakers with independent, outcomes-based intelligence that measures program effectiveness, graduate success, workforce mobility, and long-term institutional impact. By moving beyond self-reported metrics, our platform helps funders allocate capital with greater confidence, transparency, and measurable social return.

Non-Profit and Mission-Driven Organizations

Organizations dedicated to expanding educational access and creating lasting pathways to opportunity require more than reporting. They need a trusted framework for measuring and amplifying impact. Cohort Science™ provides the analytical infrastructure to quantify student success, workforce outcomes, and community transformation, enabling nonprofits and mission-driven organizations to build enduring partnerships with funders, institutions, and employers. As expectations for accountability and measurable impact continue to grow, our platform helps organizations not only demonstrate value today, but shape the future of educational and economic mobility for generations to come.

sections.label: Products
sections.heading: Three Products. One Platform. Built for the decisions that matter.
sections.html:
How Our Products Help Clients

Three Products. One Platform. Built for the decisions that matter.

Empowering institutional leaders and strategic partners with the intelligence needed to drive enrollment growth, strengthen graduate outcomes, and maximize institutional impact.

Market Signal™

Forecast Demand. Optimize Growth.

  • Predict enrollment demand and revenue potential for new and existing academic programs using market and demographic intelligence
  • Identify high-value student markets by geography, population, and program affinity to improve recruitment effectiveness
  • Model the impact of tuition, financial aid, and marketing strategies to support data-driven enrollment planning

Education Outcomes Platform™

Measure Success Beyond Graduation.

  • Track graduate employment, earnings, and career progression across institutions, programs, and graduating cohorts
  • Identify the programs that drive the strongest workforce and economic outcomes, supporting curriculum and investment decisions
  • Strengthen employer partnerships and align academic offerings with evolving labor market demand

Impact Audit™

Independent. Evidence-Based. Investor-Grade.

  • Evaluate program effectiveness, grant impact, and return on investment through objective, data-driven analysis
  • Deliver accreditation, board, and philanthropic reporting with rigorous outcomes measurement and benchmarking
  • Identify strategic opportunities for resource allocation and institutional growth through independent performance intelligence

sections.label: Why Cohort Science
sections.heading: Built for leadership. Powered by proprietary AI. Grounded in real-world decisions.
sections.html:
Why Cohort Science™

Built for leadership. Powered by proprietary AI. Grounded in real-world decisions.

Cohort Science™ brings together institutional expertise, proprietary data infrastructure, and advanced AI to deliver intelligence leaders can act on across investment, strategy, and institutional management.

We are sector specialists. Our team includes economists, engineers, data scientists, and mathematicians. Our models are built exclusively for higher education, incorporating the variables that matter: program-level economics, geographic demand dynamics, labor market trajectories, and the demographic forces reshaping the sector.

sections.html:
Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy describes how Cohort Science™ collects, uses, and protects information submitted through our website and contact forms.

We may collect information you provide directly, such as name, email, organization, and message details. We use this information to respond to requests, provide relevant services, and improve communications.

We do not sell personal information. We may use trusted service providers to help operate the site and communications. Information may also be disclosed when required by law.

If you would like to request updates or deletion of submitted information, please contact us through the website contact form.

Last updated: May 14, 2026.
